newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China sets loan.
newsitem.headline: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China sets loan.

text.p: A US$58 million term loan facility for Industrial and Commercial Bank of China is now in general syndication, bankers said.
BA Asia is the mandated arranger, they said.
The facility has a final maturity of six years and repayment is in seven equal semi-annual installments after three years' grace.
It pays an interest margin of 33 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Management fees are eight basis points for senior managers committing US$4 million or more and five basis points for managers committing US$2-3 million.
